subject: dym-f
title: DYM.F.------PROG.CONT.
description: Chart on book p. 214 (WAC-12). DYM-F (dynamic functionalism) is the subject, with the (C) prefix, "the concept of"; PROG-CONT (progressional continuance) is the partner. From the subject: EXP-DY (expansion dynamics) and SOC-RT (social reality). From EXP-DY: MT-INFO (multi-information). From MT-INFO: C-INFO (composite information) and POST (postulation), with the (R) prefix, "the reality of". From SOC-RT: POL-DY (political dynamics). From POL-DY: TR (transformation). From TR: UNF-PI (unification (positively intended)) and VT-ATT (vibrational attitude). From VT-ATT: AFL (affinity alignment).
